startup_current_directory.observation: The startup routine passes the GetCurrentDirectoryW buffer directly to editor path initialization.

database_root.observation: The database-root field is derived from the supplied startup working directory.

master_export.observation: The export routine formats Master.dat beneath the stored database-root field.

fm13_registry_read.observation: This Editor startup registry path reads Locale; the export-root sequence uses the working-directory-derived database field.

constraints: The runtime must be a direct child of C:\FM27CommunityOverhaul\runtime.
EdManager.exe must be a direct child of that runtime.
Manager.exe and database must exist in that runtime.
database\Master.dat must be absent before launch.
SetCurrentDirectoryW and ShellExecuteExW lpDirectory both bind the child to the same runtime.

conclusion: With this launcher and the verified empty runtime export target, the Editor's computed Master.dat destination is C:\FM27CommunityOverhaul\runtime\game-test-20260912-07\database\Master.dat. No export was attempted because the requireAdministrator consent surface was not targetable.
